basis: The 1990 Urban and Rural values are not explicitly labeled with text on the chart. The decision relies on the relative vertical positions of the markers at the 1990 tick. The red dashed line (Rural) is positioned significantly higher on the chart than the blue solid line (Urban) at 1990. The visual evidence and the O/B checks (specifically rec_01 and rec_02) support the conclusion that the Rural percentage is larger than the Urban percentage in 1990.
